subject: general
question: Piyush starts from Point A and drives 54 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 56 km, turns right and drives 59 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 61 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 5 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given:**

Piyush starts from Point A.

1. Drives 54 km north

2. Turns right and drives 56 km

3. Turns right and drives 59 km

4. Turns right and drives 61 km

5. Turns right and drives 5 km to reach Point P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11a51902fdd01a1e431901ac7715880210150d8c863e3cfff51b48ccf95cb5ea.png] 

Net movement = 5 km west

So, Point P is 5 km west of Point A.

To reach Point A again, Piyush must travel **5 km towards the east**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
